[b]Wuloosyan-Rosenmarkket War: Aftermath of Operation Unrelenting Resolve [/b]

[Spoiler=Aftermath]

It's been an hour now, an hour of sitting in this damned office waiting for communication on if the strike was successful. He knew the risks before he launched his operation, and of course he could tell himself that he did the right thing...but did he? He was ready for a call saying "We lost x amount of aircraft" or "We didn't hit anything" or maybe a combination of the two. The phone rings. Julian jumps up and grabs it, almost pulling it out of the desk.

"Mr. President." 

"Yes?" Julian replies. 

"This is Vanderrow. I've received an update from the lead pilot and the OSS about the operation."

"Ah, Vanderrorw! Good news, I hope." He says, trying to remain positive.

"Yes, sir. The mission was successful"

"That's wonderful, Vanderrow!" Julian says booming, "What was all of that lament for?" Of course, Wuloosya was going to win against an inferior xeno enemy.

"What are our losses?" he says again.

"None. Mr. President, all aircraft are reporting no damage and no crew losses. In fact, despite my initial assessment that it wouldn't work, we've taken out 5 and damaged 3 more.

"That's...GREAT. See, I told you, Vanderrow. I know what I am doing. Vanderrow, inform Manhatten AFB I'm on my way. I want to greet the airman and give them a good speech.

"Yes, sir."

He puts down the phone and dials the White House Chief of Staff.

"Vivian, get Bear Force One ready, would you? I need to go to Manhattan AFB. Also call my wife, would you?"

______________________________________________________________

It was 11 am, a few hours after the attack had fully concluded. By now, the president was on his way back from the airbase; he had sure taken his time. Kori looked around the room. He, for some reason, knew this wasn't just going to be any old cabinet meeting. Rozen was looking through files in a panic; communications from the Floueschian, Vespurian, Hydronian, and many other THEP-aligned embassies denounced Wuloosya. Caleb Roemers, the commerce secretary, was sitting, both hands against his cheeks, as he watched Wuloosyan stock markets plunge from the news of the strikes. The director of national intelligence was just drinking some coffee, although he had voiced his opposition to the strikes before the meeting directly to Kori.

"This emergency meeting is now in session. We should begin with the agenda item: 1. "The reading of the report on the strikes from the war secretary, Riderveld?"

Tomas Riderveld, standing up in his seat with some papers, "Well, yes,papers, said, of course. I'm sure you will all be happy to know we took zero casualties and zero equipment losses, and we have inflicted great damage upon Rosenmarkkee and their ability to interfere with the communications of the defense forces. In total, we destroyed 5 stations, and 3 have been damaged. Particularly of importance to our future operations

"Excuse me. FUTURE OPERATIONS?" Rozen lashes out, hitting the table, shocking everyone in the room.

"You're planning to do more? Excuse me, but we first met about the Rosenmarkkee situation. I was told we would put economic pressure, not send the air force to bomb them with the HDF overnight. And now you want to do MORE? ARE YOU CRAZY?

Do you realize the firestorm you've created for the state depart"

Calm down, please. "Debates on the strike are agenda item 2," Kori says.

"Shut the hell up, you lackey; I want an answer now. What are these future operations? Riderveld."

"We want to secure a series of victories against Rosenmarkee to eliminate them as a threat and prove the value of Wuloosya to the EDU. So far, we have, as the intelligence director informed me, Rosenmarkkee is mobilizing their navy; we need to eliminate their navy and capture the Ros"

"Riderveld, with all due respect...that is pure insanity; that's a pipe dream. The Defense Forces can barely quell civil unrest. You expect them to beat a military with far more experience than us?" 

Ironmoor interjects, severely regretting his decision to inform the president of Riderveld's suggestion now.

"And what about the international community? You think they're just going to let us continue this war? Are you crazy?" Rozen again interjects. Kori sighs; he can't control this now.

Janrik Woolman, Secretary of Treasury, speaks up.

"Look, the way I see it, we own the narrative right now; eyes are on us. We just won, right? The EDU helped us, right? We can exaggerate a few details, say we needed to do it for national security or whatever."

"You're out of your mind if you think THEP and the rest of the world are gullible enough to fall for that. THEP is already pissed at us; Rosenmarkkee is making preparations for retaliation; their diplomat won't even talk to me right now; and Floueschia has told us they're making preparations to send their navy over."

"That's cute from the Floueschians." Daniel Frostman, head of the FIB, says

"It is, Rozen. You don't seriously believe Floueschia, who doesn't even really have a navy outside of what, a light carrier, a cruiser, and some corvettes and frigates, is any serious threat to the WDF, or hell, even the HDF?" Riderveld joins in.

"I'm trying to avoid getting us dragged into a Third World War, dumbass. What do you think is going to happen if they aren't bluffing? Do you even understand what you've done?" Rozen replies.

"What about the domestic situation? Have you seen the markets? They're all down, every single market." Caleb Roemers says, finally looking up from doomscrolling the economic fallout

"The liberals in Congress are already denouncing us...Several unions have declared they might strike if the war continues; this might tear our economy in half."

"Well, I mean, that's what we have the National Emergencies Act for, yeah? Push comes to shove, we invoke it, get the military on the streets, and quiet them down," Frostman says, laughing.

"You're talking about martial law; are you crazy? Are you drunk? Are you just hellbent on sabotaging the midterms or something, Frostman?" 

"Alright...look...let's just end this meeting; it's been 10 minutes, and we didn't even finish the first agenda item. If you have something you want to say, say it to the president. We will have another meeting with him in the afternoon. " Kori says almost everyone arguing looks like they're about to say something...

"Meeting adjourned." Everyone shuffles out of the room; the arguing parties eye each other. Roomer mumbles something about "resignation" [/Spoiler].

___________________________________________________________________

[b]Operation Wailord [/b]

The Office of Strategic Services had finished its analysis of surveillance data from Rosenmarkee around 3 days after the strike. The data had been gained using 2 KH-100 Deoxys imaging reconnaissance satellites that were already in orbit of Rosenmarakee and one Rayquaza SAR imaging reconnaissance satellite that had been maneuvered into a position above Rosenmarakee shortly before combat operations began by the OSS. This would be the first time a Rayquaza SAR had been used, and the data it had gained had proven to be invaluable to the OSS, locating almost all of Rosenmarkee's carriers that were currently based in Rosenmarkkee, as well as the location of several major targets such as naval bases, naval fuel storage, coastal air bases, fortifications on the islands, bunker complexes on the mainland, air bases, air fuel storage, and the fact that several Rosenmarkkee submarines were not present where they should be around this time, indicating that they had been moved into the White Sea. This part was especially concerning to the Joint Chiefs of Staff, who were concerned that Rosenmarkee was planning to either interrupt Wuloosyan shipping or attack Wuloosyan or HDF military ships in the White Sea. And given Strømm's speech, it was unlikely that de-escalation of the situation was still possible. Given this, a special command was formed. This command, named the Joint Operations Room for the White Sea Conflict (JORWSC), is tasked with the primary purpose of coordinating between the command structures of the WDF, WDNK, WDEF, WDMK, and WDSK for all future operations during this conflict. Appointed at its head is Matthias Vanderrow, the highest-ranking general in the WDEF, who is given much of the authority over the joint command, although due to protests from the navy, he ends up having to share this authority with Hendel Crossrik, an admiral in the WDNK. The command is given vast autonomy from the civilian structure of the WDF and the ability to authorize military actions without the direct approval of the president. The JORWSC makes its way to Manhattan AFB, where much of the war will be planned due to its strategic location on the White Sea.

The JORWSC plan, codenamed Operation Wailord, will attempt to leverage Wuloosya's technological supremacy over the larger Rosenmarkkee navy to stage a series of devastating naval battles that will eliminate the Rosenmarkkee navy's threat to future operations to capture the Rosenmarkket white sea islands. However, this presents as a significant problem to the JORWSC. So far Rosenmarkkee has not actually deployed its navy, so somehow Wuloosya will have to bait them into deploying it in a position that wouldn't be necessarily advantageous to them. Noting that the OSS had discovered several Rosenmarkket submarines had left their ports a few days earlier, it was decided to begin hunting these submarines using Wolf Pack Delta, an all Kunli-class submarine (Seawolf-class submarine) that was specifically dedicated to hunting other submarines, supported by the signals intelligence ship UKS Emrik Broadmoor and 3 MC-24 "Mantine" maritime patrol aircraft. The UKS Emrik Broadmoor would begin by deploying to the White Sea and begin listening for enemy communications that could lead them to the submarines, while the 3 MC-24s would begin blanketing the region the OSS suspected they were currently deployed in with sonobuoys, while using their Magnetic Anomaly Detectors to cover the rest of the combat area. the Kunli-class submarines themselves would use there passive sonar to search on there own, there efforts would be directly supported by the WDSK who would redoploy another KH-100 Deoxys IRS over the white sea to see if they could catch any instance of the submarines surfacing.  Meanwhile, all of Wuloosya's Hypersonic Glide Vehicle launchers would be moved to the coastline. Under the command of the 1st Artillery Regiment, these vehicles would be attached to ballistic missiles, which would launch and then detach from these missiles once they near their target, before gliding down at hypersonic speeds, making them nearly impossible to intercept towards their target. These targets would be high-value targets such as docked carriers and major surface combatants. 

This would also be followed up by the moving of the new Lockheed anti-ship ballistic missile launchers to the coastline as well, the YJ-15, YJ-17, YJ-18, YJ-19, and YJ-21, their targets also being carriers, but also minor surface combatants and support ships, along with support on the ground for the second stage of the operation. The WDEF would also once again contribute the 81st Attack Squadron, freshly mobilized and based out of Lislarney to the operation, their mission to launch another 60 AGM-158b JASSM-ER stand-off cruise missiles at various naval facilities such as fuel depots, repair facilities, and stockpiles of equipment across the Rosenmarkkett coast under escort from the 91st Fighter Squadron. While also committing several other air wings, those being the 73rd Fighter Squadron, 12th Fighter Squadron, 88th Fighter Squadron, and 7th Fighter Squadron, to air sweeps of the combat region of the White Sea. It's hoped that by bombarding Rosenmarkkee's naval assets and, in tandem, aggressively hunting their submarines, it will constitute an escalation that will force Rosenmarkkee politically and militarily to begin deploying its navy to the White Sea to protect these assets and reassure its populace that it is, in fact, doing something against "Wuloosyan aggression."

Once and if this objective is achieved, the second stage of the operation would be activated; Surface Action Groups 1 through 3 would be mobilized and prepared to enter the White Sea. Once the Rosenmarkket Navy began to leave port, they would begin aggressively approaching the Rosenmarkket islands, pretending like they had intentions to bombard them, but always staying out of ballistic missile range of Rosenmarkket. These maneuvers would force the Rosenmarkket navy into an engagement to prevent the fake bombardment, at which point the surface action groups, supported by the ground-based ballistic missile launchers of the WDF and airwings of WDEF, would seek to inflict maximum casualties and losses upon the Rosenmarkkee navy, forcing their retreat and securing the waters around the Rosenmarkkett White Sea Islands. The HDF is, of course, informed and encouraged to assist in stage 1 of the operation and equally informed that their help likely will not be required for the second stage of the operation should stage 1 be successful.

Stage One of Operation Wailord begins on the 13th of March at 8 pm, with the 81st Attack Squadron and the 91st Fighter Squadron leaving their bases while 15 Hypersonic Glide Vehicles and around a 100 other ballistic missiles are being launched across the White Sea. These missiles should arrive to their designated targets in less than 2 hours; meanwhile, Wuloosyan airborne and early warning aircraft monitor the Rosenmarkkee air deployment. Should a significant deployment that would pose a risk to the 81st or 91st be detected, they would be ordered to turn around and not carry out their portion of the strikes, like last time they launched their 60 AGM-158B JASSM-ER across the Rosenmarkkee coastline targeting naval bases and important facilities within them. By now these targets should also be beginning to be bombarded by ballistic missiles, while the hypersonic glide vehicles being near impossible to intercept should strike true at their targets. These ballistic missiles should still reasonably have a chance to be intercepted, and therefore 50 more are launched just in case some of them are. With Operation Wailord now in full effect, the president submits a bill to the Senate to approve military operations. This bill passes quickly as an emergency session of Congress was ongoing. While the House protests, only the Senate's approval is needed, and most of the Senate is controlled by Julian loyalists. After doing this, he goes on national TV to speak to the Wuloosyan people.

____________________________________________________________________________________________

[Spoiler=Julian's Speach]"We will be on air in...1...2...3."

Says one of the men recording the speech, Julian looks towards him before looking down at his prewritten speech, carefully combed over by advisors and scriptwriters from the Secretary Department.

"My fellow Wuloosyans, good afternoon from your president. I hope that all of you have had a blessed day, regardless of the current circumstances.

Earlier this month, as you may know, the brave airmen of the Wuloosyan Defense Force launched a strike on my orders to disable a major threat to the Wuloosyan Defense Force and our national sovereignty propagated by Rosenmarkee, which is controlled by a communist gang that has driven their nation towards instability and aggression to the rest of the region. It was our hope that the Rosenmarkeet would back down from their interference and come to the table to negotiate with us. That we would be able to ensure the great dove of peace continues to fly high above Erene. This has proven not to be the case. The Office of Strategic Services informed me that Rosenmarkkee has begun to mobilize its forces and has deployed several submarines to attack Wuloosyan shipping and WDNK ships within the White Sea. 

This is unacceptable, and Wuloosya must act in its own self-defense against the continued aggression that Rosnemarkee has constantly propagated against us, the EDU, and the vast majority of Erene. Therefore, a few minutes ago, I authorized the first stage of a sustained, strategic military campaign to eliminate the threat that the Rosenmarkket navy poses to us and the world. Our allies in the HDF have agreed to support this operation. 

I know that many of you are concerned that this war may bring terrible consequences to our shores, that this war may bring horrible casualties, or that we may even lose this war. But I assure you, this will not pass; our brave soldiers, sailors, and airmen of the WDF will come home triumphant, defeating the xeno globalist enemy and defending the honor of Wuloosya and the Elesyeran people. I ask for your patience and shared effort; all of us have a part to play in the upcoming conflict, from the shining factories that will fuel our military to railworkers ensuring that trains carrying military equipment are able to reach their destination to maintenance personnel of the defense force ensuring everything is running to the simple person praying for our victory. It will be through one combined national effort that we will achieve total victory over Rosenmarkkee.

God is with us.

God bless you all, and God bless Wuloosya!"[/Spoiler]
